videos.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 138 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Concerned about Yash's health, Pankaj tells Vidhi that he could not trust Aarti any longer. Vibha tries to make Pankaj understand that Aarti too is worried about Yash and hence they must support her.

videos.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 139 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Maya red-handedly catches Ansh stealing money from the locker. She goes and complains to Suraj Pratap and the rest of the family about it. The family gets surprised when Ansh and Palak inform them that they stole the money for Yash's treatment.

videos.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 140 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Yash gets upset when he learns that Palak, Payal and Ansh had gone along with Aarti to the Dubey residence. Suraj Pratap tries his best to ask Yash what had happened in Mumbai, however Yash refuses to answer.

videos.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 141 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Bhanwari calls Vidhi up and informs her about a certain thing which was probably the reason why Yash was upset. Aman convinces Aarti that they must meet Yash and explain to him in detail what had happened on a certain rainy day night. Pankaj and Prateik get Yash drunk and compel him to reveal about a certain thing which was bothering him.

videos.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 142 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Aarti tells Vidhi and the rest of the family that Aman is her college friend and Yash did not mind their friendship. She also tells the family that Aman wanted to see whether Yash had feelings for her and so he deliberately tried to get him jealous at various intervals.

videos.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 143 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Aman and Aarti try their best to tell the family that nothing had happned between them on a certain night. The duo says that they had returned home late that night as they had got stuck in traffic.

videos.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 144 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Gayatri tries her best to make Aarti accept whether she had got intimate with Aman. Maya states that Aarti does not have evidence to prove her evidence. The family gets shocked when Aarti states that she would go to any extent to prove her innocence.

videos.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 145 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Shobha gets shocked when her husband informs her that Prashant had called. Shobha and Aarti get shocked when Ansh states that he knows that Prashant is his father.

videos.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 146 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Aarti believes that Yash must have learnt about the fact that she is a divorcee and hence was upset with her. She decides to go and reveal the truth to the Scindia family. Satyendra informs Shobha that Prashant is having problems in his marital life. Shobha curses Prashant and believes that he was being punished for deserting Ansh and Aarti.

videos.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 147 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Shobha gets furious when Satyendra states that Aarti could reunite with Prashant if Yash leaves her. Satyendra tries to make Shobha understand that Yash has not accepted Aarti as his wife. Shobha and Satyendra get elated when doctor informs them about Aarti's pregnancy. Shobha tells Satyendra that she would not tolerate if Prashant tries to interfere in Aarti's life.

videos.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 148 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Gayatri asks Aarti to return to the Scindia residence as Yash misses the children. Arti is left wondering as she does not know how she would tell Gayatri about her pregnancy. She believes that Yash thinks that he had committed a mistake by consummating their marriage. Barfi notices Aarti sitting sadly near a tea stall. He manages to cheer Aarti up. Arti remembers the incident wherein Aman had compelled her and Yash to consume bhang. Under the influence of the drink, Aarti and Yash enjoy their self to the fullest.

videos.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 149 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Aarti and Yash get high on bhang. Aarti finds a video footage in her cellphone. On playing the footage, Aarti finds out that she and Yash had spent quality time with each other. She also gets surprised when she finds out that under the influence of bhang, she and Yash had consummated their marriage.

videos.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 150 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Aarti recollects the moments when she and Yash had consummated their marriage. Aarti tells Shobha that she wants to make Yash realise that they had not committed any mistake. Aarti decides to inform Yash about her pregnancy, however Shobha stops her. Paridhi refuses to participate in household chores. Aarti gets shocked when she learns that Yash has gone to the boxing stadium

videos.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 151 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Yash holds Aarti responsible for tricking him in order to get intimate with him. Aarti refuses the blames and confesses her love for Yash. Yash had promised Arpita that he would never accept any other female in his life. A furious Yash insults his and Aarti's relationship. To punish himself, Yash decides to participate in a boxing competition. When Aarti returns home, Shobha tries to cheer her up. She tells Aarti to make Yash realize that they have not done any mistake by getting intimate.

videos.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 152 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Aarti and Yash miss each other. They also recollect the moments they spent with each other. On Pratik's request, Aarti rushes to the boxing club. Over there she learns that Yash has decided to participate in the boxing competition. Aarti decides to stop Yash from endangering his life and so rushes to Scindia mansion to change his decision. When Aarti visits Scindia Mansion, she confronts Yash for insulting their relationship. He gets furious when Aarti again confesses her love for him. She advises him to apologize to Arpita for breaking her trust, instead of punishing himself by participating in the boxing competition. Yash, however, remains determined and decides to punish himself.

videos.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 153 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Yash decides to participate in the boxing competition to repent his mistake of getting intimate with Aarti. Aarti tries to change Yash's decision but fails. Shobha advises Aarti not to change Yash's decision, instead support him as she is confident that Yash would win the competition. Gayatri is worried about Yash and shares her worries with Surajpratap. The couple gets scared when no one responds to the landline number at the Scindia Mansion. Pratik, Vidhi and Maya go to the boxing club to stop Yash from participating in the boxing competition but fail. Yash gets furious when Aarti arrives along with their children. The family gets surprised when Aarti does not stop Yash, instead supports him. After Yash leaves, Aarti convinces the trio to support Yash so that he wins the competition. The trio agrees to do so.

videos.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 154 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Yash recollects the conversation wherein Kareena had got impressed with him as he had arranged the event for her upcoming movie very efficiently. Yash and his opponent, Tyson, enter the boxing arena. Ansh cheers for Yash during the game. Maya curses Aarti as Yash had participated in the fight because of him.

videos.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 155 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Yash, who is badly wounded, believes that he could see Arpita. Arpita motivates Yash to win the competition. Yash hits Tyson and wins the competition.Shobha tells Aarti that she must reveal the truth to Yash. The Scindias welcome Yash and praise him on his victory. Maya gets irritated when Vidhi tells Aarti to perform Yash's arti. Vidhi further praises Aarti for taking care of Yash. Suraj Pratap gets elated when Vidhi informs him that Aarti has returned to the Scindia house. Suraj Pratap and Gayatri express their happiness over the phone.

videos.title: Punar Vivaah - Episode 156 - Full Episode
videos.overview: Gayatri gets elated when Yash tells her that he is happy. Before disconnecting the call, Gayatri tells Aarti that when she and Yash have their child, her son would never get upset with her. Yash pacifies Ansh and Payal when Aarti shouts at them.
